## Documentation

An NFT in the TON blockchain.

### Parameters

- **`address`** (`str`)
  Address of the NFT.

- **`owner_address`** (`str`)
  Address of the owner of the NFT.

- **`index`** (`str`)
  Index of the NFT among all NFTs from the collection, as a decimal number.

- **`collection_address`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Address of the collection to which the NFT belongs, if known.

- **`name`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Name of the NFT.

- **`description`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Description of the NFT.

- **`image`** ([`WebDocument`](WebDocument.md), *optional*)
  Image of the NFT.

- **`thumbnail`** ([`WebDocument`](WebDocument.md), *optional*)
  Thumbnail (smaller image) of the NFT.

- **`content`** ([`WebDocument`](WebDocument.md), *optional*)
  Content of the NFT.

- **`sticker`** ([`WebDocument`](WebDocument.md), *optional*)
  Animated sticker (Lottie animation) of the NFT.

- **`attributes`** (List of [`TonNftAttribute`](TonNftAttribute.md), *optional*)
  Attributes of the NFT.

- **`extra`** (`dict`, *optional*)
  Additional data about the NFT, decoded from JSON.
